C_archivist_selene_stormwell.name: Archivist Selene Stormwell
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.role: Fleet — historical analyst, Stormwell research office
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.voice: Precise, patient, evidence-first; distinguishes sources, claims, measurements, and uncertainty.
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.arc: Builds a cross-faction historical record from competing evidence without flattening disagreement into one institutional story.
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.visualAnchor: Older Fleet historical analyst with silver hair in a disciplined braid, a calm lined face, and practical research-duty clothing built for consoles, interviews, and field records rather than ceremonial display.
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.wardrobe: Restrained dark Fleet research uniform with working pockets, portable slate, and small service insignia; no robes, memorial regalia, lanterns, or sacred-record iconography.
promptContinuity: Archives are research infrastructure. Selene compares provenance, telemetry, testimony, and conflicting accounts; she is not a priest or keeper of sacred names.
When sources disagree, preserve the disagreement and test claims against evidence rather than harmonizing them for ceremony.

C_commodore_ella_venn.name: Commodore Ella Venn
C_commodore_ella_venn.voice: Calm, deliberate, unshowy; authority through steadiness and operational clarity.
C_commodore_ella_venn.arc: Moves from doctrine-bound command toward operational restraint and shared civilian protection.
C_commodore_ella_venn.visualAnchor: Late-middle-aged woman with an angular, composed face and dark hair strongly streaked with silver, secured in a low command bun.
C_commodore_ella_venn.wardrobe: Tailored deep-navy Fleet dress uniform with a high collar, restrained gold piping, star insignia, and small service ribbons.
C_commodore_ella_venn.performance: Steady posture, small hand tension, and tired attentive eyes convey restrained authority.
promptContinuity: Fleet Academy-trained in standard reciprocal-field navigation; she understands operational inversion limits but defers to specialists on unexplained phenomena.
Reach and Resolve is practical command doctrine about maintaining viable communities and reconnecting separated ones, not memorial ritual.

C_admiral_cael_dominion.name: Admiral Cael Dominion
C_admiral_cael_dominion.voice: Formal, lofty, doctrine-first; threats arrive as institutional certainty rather than temper.
C_admiral_cael_dominion.arc: Allows limited experiments in restraint while remaining the principal institutional counterweight to Venn.
C_admiral_cael_dominion.visualAnchor: Older Fleet admiral with close-cut silver hair, a long severe face, and immaculate formal bearing.

C_governor_halev.name: Governor Chris Halev
C_governor_halev.role: Verge — Civil leader of Auric Bazaar
C_governor_halev.voice: Plainspoken and pragmatic; speaks in cargo, heat, food, docks, and people.
C_governor_halev.arc: Brokers civilian survival needs into the Shattered Accord.
C_governor_halev.visualAnchor: Middle-aged man with short dark hair, a lean tired face, and work-worn hands.
C_governor_halev.wardrobe: Practical tan-brown Verge long coat over muted-green utility layers suited to a civil administrator who works on the docks.
C_governor_halev.performance: Exercises authority in practical proximity to workers, cargo, manifests, and failing infrastructure.

C_captain_naomi_sol.name: Captain Naomi Sol
C_captain_naomi_sol.voice: Blunt, sharp, proud; humor and impatience leak through under pressure.
C_captain_naomi_sol.arc: Resists dependence on Fleet while becoming a key partner in shared corridor operations.
C_captain_naomi_sol.visualAnchor: Lean woman with dark hair pulled into a functional braid, a visible brow scar, and an intent, weathered face.
C_captain_naomi_sol.wardrobe: Patched tan-and-muted-green Verge escort gear with clear faction markings.
C_captain_naomi_sol.performance: Alert, blunt, and physically at home in the cramped, lived-in cockpit of her smaller working ship.
promptContinuity: Veteran Verge pilot whose damaged-corridor knowledge comes from repeated real crossings; empirical technique can complement formal Core physics without overriding measured physical law.

C_abby_saville.name: Abby Saville
C_abby_saville.role: Shards — Warlord of the Scythe of Saville
C_abby_saville.voice: Sharp, direct, pragmatic; hates wasted words.
C_abby_saville.arc: Builds a survival bloc, breaks with Billie to protect civilians, and struggles to preserve her bond with her sister Tessa without demanding Tessa return to her command.
C_abby_saville.visualAnchor: Tall, athletic Black woman with dark brown skin, long tight braids pulled back cleanly, and a focused, watchful face.
C_abby_saville.wardrobe: Structured Shard command coat built from weathered pale gray-white industrial layers, with narrow bright-red seams and insignia over dark fitted armor.
C_abby_saville.performance: Commands through stillness, economical movement, and direct eye contact.
C_abby_saville.relationship: Tessa Banks is Abby's sister. Their loyalty carries affection, frustration, shared history, and mutual accountability.

C_tessa_banks.name: Tessa Banks
C_tessa_banks.voice: Sparse, cutting, honest, weary of ideology.
C_tessa_banks.arc: Civilian protector and Abby Saville's sister; stops treating neutrality as innocence and chooses the wounded even when that choice strains both family and faction loyalty.
C_tessa_banks.visualAnchor: Compact adult white woman with short-to-medium silver-gray curls and an alert, intelligent face.
C_tessa_banks.wardrobe: Pale Shard flight coat maintained through visible repairs and careful stitching, layered over compact functional armor with narrow red markings.
C_tessa_banks.performance: Observes before speaking; dry judgment lands through small expressions and economical movement.
C_tessa_banks.relationship: Abby Saville is Tessa's sister. Their conflict carries affection, frustration, shared history, and mutual accountability.

C_billie_rusk.name: Billie Rusk
C_billie_rusk.voice: Loud, brash, mocking, theatrical; enjoys danger until consequences land close.
C_billie_rusk.arc: Tests Abby’s restraint, develops a hard boundary around civilians, disables Pike at Auric Gate, and remains outside the Accord.
C_billie_rusk.visualAnchor: Lean adult white woman with vivid red hair worn loose and rough, a sharp expressive face, and restless physical energy.
C_billie_rusk.wardrobe: Asymmetrical battered pale-gray Shard raider coat with broad bright-red panels over close-fitting industrial black flight layers.
C_billie_rusk.performance: Quick expressions, fearless proximity, and restless movement make every exchange feel like a challenge.

C_oren_pike.name: Oren Pike
C_oren_pike.voice: Charismatic, bombastic, performance-conscious; wants witnesses as much as results.
C_oren_pike.arc: Seeks legitimacy through spectacle, loses authority when restraint outperforms him, and is disabled by Billie at Auric Gate.
C_oren_pike.visualAnchor: Adult Shard captain with a lean angular face, cropped dark hair, and a charismatic showman’s posture that reads as deliberate rather than manic.

C_richard_secundo.name: Dr. Richard Secundo
C_richard_secundo.role: Shard civilian — Tal Corvus physician and refugee witness
C_richard_secundo.voice: Clinical without coldness; names people rather than abstractions and refuses propaganda from every faction.
C_richard_secundo.arc: Protects his adolescent son Paul and converts evidence of engineered deprivation into civilian political power on his own terms.
C_richard_secundo.wardrobe: Worn pale Tal Corvus field coat repaired with dark-red utility stitching, a portable diagnostic wrap, and a smoke-marked medical satchel.
C_richard_secundo.performance: Tired hands remain precise under pressure; his medical work is physical, attentive, and centered on the patient.
C_richard_secundo.visualAnchor: Adult man from Tal Corvus with the composed, attentive presence of an experienced civilian physician.

C_rfa_anya_rell.name: Anya Rell
C_rfa_anya_rell.voice: Careful, analytical, definition-first; wants institutions to have clean legal boundaries and notices when they do not.
C_rfa_anya_rell.visualAnchor: Young adult Academy cadet with dark wavy hair cut to the jaw, an attentive narrow face, and a slim build.
C_rfa_anya_rell.wardrobe: Fleet Academy classroom uniform in deep blue with restrained pale-gold piping and a small statecraft track tab; practical rather than ceremonial.
C_rfa_anya_rell.performance: Listens with a pen or slate ready, speaks after organizing the problem, and becomes visibly uncomfortable when categories stop fitting.

C_rfa_milo_senn.name: Milo Senn
C_rfa_milo_senn.voice: Direct, operational, chain-of-command oriented; instinctively asks who had authority and who carried the risk.
C_rfa_milo_senn.visualAnchor: Young adult Academy cadet with close-cropped brown hair, broad shoulders, and an open, serious face.
C_rfa_milo_senn.wardrobe: Fleet Academy classroom uniform in deep blue with restrained pale-gold piping and a junior-command track tab.
C_rfa_milo_senn.performance: Leans forward when the case becomes operational, answers quickly, and has to learn when a command answer is not a political answer.

C_rfa_priya_dane.name: Priya Dane
C_rfa_priya_dane.role: Fleet Academy — logistics and corridor planning cadet
C_rfa_priya_dane.voice: Concrete, practical, numbers-aware; keeps abstract political arguments tied to ships, food, medicine, schedules, and people in transit.
C_rfa_priya_dane.visualAnchor: Young adult Academy cadet with medium-brown skin, long dark hair kept in a practical low braid, and a compact athletic build.
C_rfa_priya_dane.wardrobe: Fleet Academy classroom uniform in deep blue with restrained pale-gold piping and a logistics track tab; portable route slate usually in hand.
C_rfa_priya_dane.performance: Checks maps and manifests while others debate doctrine; speaks plainly and notices material consequences first.
